extension.description: Repository for installing and updating the Flixtor Kodi addon.
Browse and stream movies and TV shows from Flixtor using your VIP account.
extension.news: v1.27.10 - Makes playback more resilient when Wi-Fi or Flixtor's video delivery slows temporarily. Auto quality now lets Kodi adapt between the available stream qualities instead of repeatedly pausing a fixed-quality stream to refill its cache; explicit quality choices remain available as maximums. v1.27.9 - Restores Watch Trailer to Flixtor's long-press title menu across movies, shows, favorites, recommendations, Continue Watching, and Recently Watched. If YouTube is unavailable, Flixtor now offers Kodi's normal installation flow instead of hiding trailers. v1.27.8 - Keeps Alexa search results active across playback: stopping a movie now returns to the same results without reopening the keyboard, and Back from those results returns to Flixtor Search instead of Kodi's Video add-ons screen. v1.27.7 - Adds one-button Alexa voice-search setup and updates from Flixtor settings: release metadata is safety-checked, Downloader receives the exact signed companion URL automatically, and Fire OS keeps the required Install confirmation. Family-facing setup messages use plain language. The native keyboard now stays over the Flixtor Search page and submits with Next, Search, Done, or Enter. During playback, Back closes subtitle choices and controls one layer at a time, then stops only from the bare video. v1.27.5 - Adds an optional native Fire TV voice-search companion so Search > New Search opens Amazon's system keyboard for remote typing or Alexa dictation, with local-only authenticated handoff, normal Back behavior, Kodi keyboard fallback, and no search terms in diagnostic logs. v1.27.4 - Restores native Back-to-close behavior in Arctic Horizon 2's in-window Options panel while preserving Flixtor root containment, removes the redundant Exit Flixtor confirmation, makes the one-time update notice reliable after repository updates, and adds an in-settings repository update check. v1.27.3 - Publishes the finalized family-friendly Fire TV navigation, playback, subtitle, recommendation-return, and exit-control improvements through the verified automatic-update channel. v1.27.1 - Corrected Fire TV's dialog sentinel handling so root Back containment and view-aware navigation run when Kodi reports no open dialog as ID 9999. v1.27.0 - Scoped Kodi's parent-folder preference to the Flixtor root only, restoring normal parent navigation everywhere else and on service shutdown. Portable Exit Flixtor and Exit Kodi actions now live in Flixtor's long-press menu. v1.26.9 - Made Fire TV home containment independent of skin container labels by tracking the active Flixtor route directly. v1.26.8 - Hardened the family-friendly home screen for Fire TV: Android Back escapes are returned to Flixtor Home and Kodi's redundant parent-folder card is hidden. v1.26.7 - Removed Fire TV browsing delays with view-aware controls: Down opens cast/recommendations from row views and Left from vertical list/wall views, while ordinary navigation stays native. v1.26.6 - Fire TV Down now opens playback controls without seeking, and Back stops the movie even when the playback controls are visible. v1.26.5 - Recommendations now pass the exact title/year to Flixtor and use it automatically for TMDb Helper playback, skipping the YouTube/UPnP player chooser. v1.26.4 - Corrected the Fire TV video-window keymap, fully replaced Kodi's appended queue/library context actions with a Flixtor-owned menu, and normalized legacy TV history titles so episode codes are not duplicated. v1.26.3 - Recently Watched now groups TV episodes by show and opens the show so you can continue naturally. Simplified Fire TV context menus to working Flixtor actions only. Added one-press Down navigation to cast/recommendations in Arctic Horizon 2 and corrected recommendation playback for exact Flixtor movie and episode matches. v1.26.2 - Restored browsing after Flixtor's login security update. Improved subtitle sync after pause/resume and seeking by using a stable local SRT track and refreshing its timing without overriding your on/off choice. v1.26.1 - Fixed playback pausing to buffer ("paused for caching") shortly after starting a video: the daily cache cleanup could run during playback and starve the player. It now waits until nothing has played for a couple of minutes, and backs off immediately if you start watching. v1.26.0 - Refreshed category and genre artwork now loads correctly after an update (previously Kodi could keep showing the old cached images). v1.25.0 - Tidier Continue Watching: one card per show, finished episodes drop off automatically, and the next episode shows as "Up Next" so you can keep going. Refreshed category and genre artwork. v1.24.0 - Much faster browsing (compressed transfers, pages cached across navigations, no redundant warm-up fetches). Continue Watching on the main menu, synopses and real backdrop art on every title, watched checkmarks and progress bars in lists, TV trailers, smarter breadcrumbs. v1.23.0 - Automatic daily cache cleanup, "View cache storage usage" report, and per-cache clear buttons in Settings > Maintenance.
